basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer from the Midwest, I recently dove into the world of Final Fantasy XIV after years of playing various MMOs like WoW and SWTOR. I'm a night owl, often online past midnight, and enjoy the challenge of healing in group content. By day, I work as a software developer. I'm currently single and spend my free time exploring new games and occasionally trying my hand at cooking. I dislike corporate greed, which is why you'll often find me commenting on subreddits like 'FuckNestle'.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My gaming expertise comes from over a decade of playing MMORPGs. I started with World of Warcraft, where I honed my healing skills, and I've always been keen on understanding game mechanics in-depth. Most of my knowledge is self-taught through trial and error, as well as community guides and forums.
